g.text: Proof bytes / 1024. Horizontal axis shows the observed range.

circle.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(13%,36%,65%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Small dots are individual samples. Ranges are not confidence intervals.
One host and one run. Proving includes local checks, OS entropy and encoding. Verification includes decoding.
Amounts are not bound to ledger notes. This is not a full private payment or transaction throughput measurement.
Timing and size observations do not establish witness indistinguishability, constant time behavior or quantum security.
Source 71bd256d404c | raw samples and source hashes retained in results/metadata.json
